reviews.reason: Instruction 005db6d4 compares SI (param_2) with 0x270f (decimal 9999). The JBE at 005db6d9 branches to success path; falling through leads directly to XOR EAX,EAX (zero return) and RET at 005db6dd. This confirms immediate false return for inputs exceeding 9999.

At 005db6f1, AX holds the result of a call to GetTableCount(), which is compared against BX (the input param_2). The conditional jump JG at 005db6f4 jumps on 'AX > BX' to the true path starting 005db700. Falling through executes XOR EAX,EAX and returns 0 when AX <= BX. Hence, equality (index >= table count) causes a false return as claimed. However, inspection reveals that equality is not excluded — indeed it's handled correctly: e.g., param_2=10 and GetTableCount() returning 10 will take the fallthrough path that zeroes EAX and returns 0. Thus this matches the claim semantically. Correction: upon re-evaluation, this statement actually aligns with the control flow since index >= GetTableCount implies (AX <= BX), leading to EAX=0 via XOR, validating the claim. It was misclassified initially; correcting now to supported_static based purely on static match.

Control reaches 005db70c where [RAX + RBX*0x8] is checked for non-zero. SETNZ AL sets AL=1 if nonzero, otherwise 0. Subsequent RET uses full RAX as return value, so only low byte matters but whole register returned by ABI convention. Matches behavior: true iff entry is non-null.

When ESI == 1, TEST ESI,ESI (007b5229) clears ZF, so the JZ at 007b522b falls through. Then CMP ESI,0x1 (007b522d) sets ZF=1 and MOV EAX,0x24 (007b5230) loads 36 into EAX. CMOVNZ EAX,EDX (007b523a) does not execute since ZF=1. RET at 007b523d returns 36.

When ESI > 1 (e.g., ESI=2), TEST ESI,ESI (007b5229) clears ZF causing fall-through at 007b522b. CMP ESI,0x1 (007b522d) clears ZF since ESI!=1. Thus, CMOVNZ EAX,EDX (007b523a) executes and copies EDX (set to 0 at 007b5235) into EAX before RET at 007b523d.
